entries.text: Worked on the Little Dart Mk IV (version 4, 11% built): I've revised the exhaust system design and tested multiple flexible heat-resistant cables and tubes from McMaster-Carr. My goal is to find the best materials for the desert moon's extreme temperatures
I keep tweaking and testing the Little Dart's design, focusing on the exhaust system.
entries.why: To ensure the Little Dart can operate safely and efficiently in the harsh desert moon environment.
